scope: 50-client dense CIFAR hybrid calibration, seed0, 6400 train / 500 evaluation, two rounds; not an accuracy benchmark

arithmetic_scenarios.definition: Illustrative serial 24/7 workload arithmetic, NOT a calibrated full-grid ETA. Uniform scenario assigns the dense hybrid mean to every round. Graph scenario scales blob time by sum(cohort_size^2)/2500, HE time by HE-only sum(cohort_size^2)/2500, and assigns 168.2s training-stage +50s reporting per round. It omits full-data training growth, different-model/dataset costs, extra cohort setup and unsampled validation/network effects; all are unvalidated assumptions.

limitations: Only CNN has a recovered verifiable per-round archive. MLP has an approximate timestamp window, not reconstructed metrics.
Two dense hybrid rounds cannot estimate every topology/mode/dataset with a defensible narrow range.
Serialized RPC JSON bytes are not NIC/TLS wire traffic. Roles ran on one host.
Main training uses full datasets and 60 rounds; calibration is a subset with two rounds.
The full campaign remains unstarted. No new thesis/dashboard accuracy results are asserted.
conclusion: Full grid is impractical in the current serial all-peer-verification implementation; optimize protocol/transport and redesign scope before bulk execution.
